title: Array Description

constraints.text: n ≤ 1e5, values in 1..m with m ≤ 100, some values unknown

explanation: Adjacent values differ by at most 1, so the state is (position, value at that position): dp[i][v] = sum of the three neighbouring values at i−1.
traps: A known value forces dp[i][v] = 0 for every other v.
Clamp v−1 and v+1 to the range 1..m.

extraLayers.prompt: What should the DP state represent?

options.text: dp[i][v] = number of valid ways to fill positions 1..i with position i equal to v
dp[i] = number of ways to fill positions 1..i
options.why: Loses the last value, which the next position depends on.

options.text: dp[v] = number of positions equal to v
dp[i][mask] = set of values used so far
options.why: Only the previous value matters, and m = 100 makes masks impossible.

extraLayers.explanation: The constraint links neighbours, so remember the value at the current position (m ≤ 100 choices).

extraLayers.prompt: Given that state, which transition is right?

options.text: dp[i][v] = dp[i−1][v−1] + dp[i−1][v] + dp[i−1][v+1], and 0 if a_i is known and ≠ v
dp[i][v] = Σ over all u of dp[i−1][u]
options.why: Ignores the 'differ by at most 1' rule.
Neighbouring values each contribute their own count; you can't just multiply.
Asks for a count (sum), not a maximum.

extraLayers.explanation: Position i with value v can follow v−1, v or v+1 at position i−1.
